const properties = {
  get constructor() {
    console.log("read constructor");
    throw new Error("constructor failed");
  },
};
const named = {
  constructor: {
    get name() {
      console.log("read name");
      return "Custom";
    },
  },
};
const badName = { constructor: { get name() { throw new Error("name failed"); } } };
for (const invalid of [properties, named, badName, { constructor: null }, { constructor: { name: "" } }, Object.create(null)]) {
  try {
    console.table([], invalid as any);
  } catch (error) {
    console.log(String(error));
  }
}
